headline: China Steel's July Pre-Tax Profit Falls 55% Month-on-Month, Turns Positive from Year-Ago Loss | Securities
summary: China Steel reported July pre-tax profit of NT$655 million, down 55% from June as steel gross profit per unit fell. The result compares with a NT$840 million pre-tax loss in the same month last year.
why: China Steel is Taiwan's largest steelmaker, and its monthly earnings signal conditions in steel pricing and margins that affect construction and manufacturing supply chains.
